cost_equivalence.reason: Node and CarryIn borrow the same TensorType; Param/Const/State borrow dtype and original u32 shape. TensorType::fixed formerly mapped every extent to Dim::Fixed, whose ordered saturating product is exactly the new Fixed product. Scalar Input formerly used empty-shape TensorType::scalar(Idx), giving one element and Idx width; new IndexScalar is identical.

Both versions compute output elements/bytes first, then visit every input in original order and saturating-add each full input byte count. Within each shape, the left fold starts at one and applies the same saturating multiply by each original extent, then dtype width. No reassociation across products or additions.

Gather remains out_elements*input0_width + input1_bytes; MatMul remains out_elements*last input0 dimension evaluated at H; reductions and TopK use same input0 elements; transcendental/Iota/default branches and HistAppend byte directions unchanged. All multiplications/additions retain the original saturating order and u64 widths.

MatMul last_extent changes the shape lookup form, but validated MatMul rank is nonzero and the same last Fixed/H extent is selected. Malformed rank/index programs remain unsupported inputs and can panic in both forms; this is not a new validator/acceptance path.

Public node_cost signature and CostV1 fields unchanged. Other ref_type/Cow/contraction/cone/admission code remains byte-identical, including fee/demand equations. No wire/domain/tag/rate/class/program/identity/authority change.
